description: Recommend up to ten matching library items from supplied goals, capabilities, environment and exclusions. Return each item with lexical match reasons; the temporary profile is not saved and no progress is changed.

idempotencyKey.description: Transport retry key, forwarded as Idempotency-Key.

locale.description: MCP transport locale; not a service input field.

profile.description: Temporary recommendation preferences. Values are matched lexically against library metadata and are not persisted.

capabilities.description: Up to 20 existing skills or capabilities to match against public library metadata; these are not saved to an account.

constraints.description: Up to 20 exclusion terms; items whose title or description contains one are removed from recommendations.

environment.description: Optional tools or working environment to match as recommendation keywords, at most 500 characters.

goals.description: Up to 20 learning goals used as temporary recommendation keywords; each may contain at most 300 characters.

name: academy_suggest

contentLocale.description: Content language: de for German, en for English or es for Spanish. The transport defaults to German when omitted.

locale.description: Content language: de for German, en for English or es for Spanish. The transport defaults to German when omitted.

type.description: Library content kind from the catalog; use the declared enum value to filter metadata rather than guessing a category.
